description.value: The Chinatown Storytelling Centre is a cultural museum operated by the Vancouver Chinatown Foundation, housed in a historic Bank of Montreal building at the corner of Main and Pender Streets in Vancouver's Chinatown. It documents the stories of Chinese Canadians through artifacts, historic photographs, head tax certificates, and interactive exhibits celebrating their contributions to building Vancouver and Canada. The centre also includes Foo Hung Curios, an in-house shop featuring contemporary work by Chinese Canadian designers and artists.
